subject: Copywriting
title: John E. Powers: The Honest Copywriter
description: A quick win: understand John E. Powers: The Honest Copywriter.

hook.text: In 1880, John E. Powers wrote: 'We have a lot of rotten umbrellas that we want to get rid of.' The store sold out.

buildup.text: Powers is considered the first modern copywriter. He worked for Wanamaker's, the first department store.

discovery.text: His approach was radical honesty. He described products truthfully, including their flaws. Customers trusted him.

twist.text: Wanamaker fired Powers for being too honest. But sales dropped so much they hired him back at double the salary.

climax.text: Powers proved that honesty sells better than hype. His direct style influenced every copywriter who came after.

punchline.text: Rotten umbrellas sold out. Honesty is powerful copy.

quiz.question: Why was John E. Powers fired and then rehired?
options: Too honest, but sales dropped without him
